title: Juicy Indian Blackeye Pea Rajma Curry
description: A citrusy, pillowy and kid-friendly Andhra style blackeye pea curry that is paleo-friendly and perfect for family meals.
instructions: Rinse the blackeye peas and soak them overnight or perform a quick soak in boiling water for 1 hour.
Drain the peas, rinse again, and simmer them in 800ml water for 45 minutes until tender.
Heat 2 tbsp peanut oil in a skillet and sauté the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger until translucent.
Add cumin, coriander, paprika, turmeric, and chili powder to the pan and cook for 1 minute to release aromas.
Pour in the tomato puree and a splash of water, then simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Stir the cooked peas into the tomato mixture and let them simmer together for 10 minutes to absorb flavors.
Add coconut milk, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and simmer for an additional 5 minutes until the curry is creamy.
Serve the curry hot over steamed rice, garnishing with fresh cilantro if desired.
